role: Real dependency repair planning from D-06's real npm audit output. Classifies real vulnerabilities via npm's own actual fixAvailable field into auto-fixable, needs-manual-review (breaking changes), and no-fix-available. Never executes npm itself — proposes a plan only.
behaviorDescription: proposeRepairPlan() classifies real npm audit vulnerabilities, verified against a real representative shape (normal fix, breaking-change fix, no-fix case) before implementation. A semver-major fix is always routed to manual review, never treated as auto-fixable.
hardStops: Never executes npm audit fix or any write action against a real lockfile — proposes a plan only
Never classifies a semver-major breaking change as auto-fixable
